rationale: NVDA has already gapped up 33% from prior close on what appears to be a macro/tariff relief rally (SPY +5%, VIXY -14.6%), and price is consolidating near 77% of today's range with the last five 1-minute candles showing tight, indecisive chop between ~$167.50 and $168.88 — no clear directional momentum or breakout structure to trade against.
